triage.note: D10 defect 1 and the highest-leverage one: the postmortem calls a parameterised start URL the single change that bypasses S1 (fetch-then-render), S3 (three identical Extract buttons) and S4 (nothing waits for the async result) at once, because the agent lands on a page that is already rendered. There was no deep link at all. Watched red against the unmodified file: all six pinned expressions missing, six failures. Green once `deepLink()` exists and `boot()` calls it. Pinned as WHOLE expressions for WIRE_UI's stated reason — a question about a hop ("does it read the query string?") is answerable by a broken hop. The pins ALSO carry the safe-degrade contract, which is the part most likely to rot: the membership guard returns before anything is assigned, so an absent or unknown `fixture` is a no-op and `run=1` alone extracts nothing. Client-side only: no server route changed, `/` still serves the same static file (ADR-free, display layer). PR #55 R1 corrected what `order` asserts. The first version pinned guard-before-run, which is inert — that order is fixed by `deepLink()`'s own function text and cannot move — while leaving unpinned the order the feature genuinely depends on: `deepLink()` must run AFTER `boot()` fills `#fx` from `/api/meta`, since the option list is exactly what its membership guard tests against. Reproduced: `deepLink();` relocated to the first line of `boot()` leaves the guard facing an empty `<select>`, so it returns every time and `?fixture=aapl-2025&run=1` silently renders nothing — measured `[PASS] ui-deep-link`, invariant 63/63 = 1.000. `order` is now the whole chain (options assignment, call site, guard, run) and that mutation is red at `out of order: 'deepLink();' (@11395) runs before '$("#fx").innerHTML = m.fixtures.map(f => `<option>${esc(f)}</option>`).join("");' (@11405)`.

provenance: D10, created 2026-08-26 before the deep link existed, per hard rule 2; `order` strengthened in the PR #55 round-1 repair, red-first on the reviewer's own relocation mutation.
